svg.title: MethodCheck script architecture: what each Python file does and how they depend on each other
svg.desc: run_experiment.py orchestrates the experiment. It calls agent.py, persona.py, stage_tracker.py, reward, and database. agent and persona call api_client.py which routes to a backend selected by model_config.py. stages.py defines the six stages used by stage_tracker and scenarios.py defines the three scenarios.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does run_experiment.py do step by step?')
sendPrompt('How does the vLLM server get launched in the Slurm job?')
sendPrompt('What does database.py and the JSON output store?')
